This '''Dianoga''' was a vicious creature that lived inside [[Garbage Compactor 3263827]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].

==Description==
Like most [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]],<ref name=":0">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> such horrible<ref>[[The Star Wars Storybook|''The Star Wars Storybook'']]</ref> and slime creature<ref>[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil|''Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil'']]</ref> was a [[Diet/Legends|homnivorous]]<ref name=":1">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="Episode IV" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|hermafrodite]]<ref name=":1" /> [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]]<ref>''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]]<ref name=":1" /> that would eat anything it could find, but it would be quick to flee when presented with danger.<ref name="Episode IV" /> It and other members of the species aboard the station were known to consume everything except for pure metals.<ref name=":2">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref>

==History==
At unknown point prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], this dianoga was known to have boarded the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]<ref>[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> quite by accident,<ref name=":3">[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope (junior novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref> one of the many creatures that infested the vast waste collection bins aboard the station.<ref name=":0" /> The Dianoga were both numerous and huge compared to those found on other starships.<ref name=":2" /> The dianoga made its home in the murky, polluted water of one of the [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] many [[Garbage compactor/Legends|garbage compactors]], where it would spend the rest of its days eating the refuse of the Death Star's occupants.<ref name="Episode IV" />

[[File:Feeling_the_Squeeze.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Dianoga attempting to drown [[Luke Skywalker]].]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref>''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the creature's "nest" would be unintentionally infiltrated by a small party consisting of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] who were trying to escape from the Death Star.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Initially scared, the dianoga was terrified by the suddent commotion in its quiet realm.<ref>{{FactFile|98|DIA 1-2|Dianoga}}</ref> Skywalker glimpsed a thick, serpentlike body twist through the muck, though Solo dismissed him.<ref name="Episode IV" /> No one saw<ref name=":3" /> the single eyestalk that rose<ref name="Episode IV" /> like a periscope<ref name=":3" /> from the muck. Upon seeing them, the dianoga's eye quickly surveyed the four figures<ref name="Episode IV" /> who appeared to be a tasty alternative to garbage.<ref name=":3" /> But the group proved persistent after the dianoga attacked Skywalker, a young farmboy and aspiring [[Jedi]]<ref name="Episode IV" /> mistook for the vermin it was there to control.<ref name=":4">{{FactFile|57|DEA 3-4|Death Star – Trash Compactor}}</ref> A membraned tentacle was wrapped around Luke's head, as he thrashed and struggled against the creature's hold. Even after Han firing at the creature, the creature held Luke tight and pulled him under again. Luckily for them, the creature let go of Skywalker and disappeared, as it was scared away when the compactor walls activated.<ref name="Episode IV" /> It was likley that the dianoga had some obscure exit through which it could flee whenever the crushing process was initiated.<ref name=":4" />

However the creature's survival against the invaders would be short-lived, as soon after the incident, the dianoga was destroyed along with the rest of the Death Star by the very same young farmboy it had tried to drown.<ref name="Episode IV" />

=== Legacy ===
The dianoga and its attack to the two [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalkers]] were mentioned in reports made by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]].<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
This creature, first appeared in the original [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="Episode IV" />

In [[George Lucas]]' revised fourth draft of ''A New Hope'', the Dianoga, was referred as "Dia Nogu". The term (or variations thereof) came to describe a nasty creature lurking about in the garbage, as the early scripts didn't always have the trash compactor aboard the Death Star. In the finished version of film, Lucas was reportedly less than impressed with the delivered Dianoga effect, having envisioned something bigger and more ominous.<ref name="DB-dianoga">{{DB|creature|dianoga|dianoga}}</ref>

Despite its brief appearance in the film, this Dianoga would continue to make regular appearances in future ''Star Wars'' media and merchandise in the many years that would follow. In [[Kenner Products]]' 1978 Death Star playset, the Dianoga was first identified as the "Death Star Trash Monster".<ref>{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars (Kenner toy line)|pack=Death Star Space Station|link=Kenner-PS-DeathStar1.asp}} {{C|as "Death Star Trash Monster"}}</ref>
